name: std::basic_ios<CharT,Traits>::imbue
intro: Replaces the current locale. Effectively calls ios_base::imbue(loc) and if there is an associated stream buffer (rdbuf() != 0), then calls rdbuf()->pubimbue(loc).

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The previous locale, as returned by ios_base::imbue(loc).

examples.output:
Current locale: en_US.UTF8
Global locale : C
